market_definition: The structural adhesive films market comprises pre-cast, solid-film epoxy, phenolic and polyurethane adhesives that cure under heat and pressure to form high-strength bonds. It measures sales of supported and unsupported films used in composites and metal bonding. BY CHEMISTRY: Epoxy, Phenolic, Polyurethane / Other. BY FORMAT: Supported (Carrier-Based), Unsupported. BY CURE TEMPERATURE: Low-Temperature (< 100 °C), Medium (100–150 °C), High (> 150 °C). BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Aerospace & Defense, Automotive Composites, Wind Energy, Marine & Rail, Sporting Goods & Leisure. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Heat-activated adhesive films for textiles and lamination; paste epoxy adhesives; prepreg resin systems; pressure-sensitive transfer tapes. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
